designIntent.audience: Support leads working a queue on a laptop for hours
designIntent.coreTask: Decide which at-risk account to open next
designIntent.visualDirection: Calm information-forward workspace; dense tables, generous section spacing, no decorative glow
principles: One analytical question dominates the first viewport
Every state keeps the same geometry
Contrast is decided from tokens, not from a screenshot
successCriteria: A support lead can name the top at-risk account within ten seconds
The at-risk list is reachable in one scroll at 320px

styleDirections.name: Quiet editorial
styleDirections.description: Type-led hierarchy, few containers, opaque surfaces

material.surface: opaque canvas and panels, one hairline border

tradeoffs: less immediately expressive than a modular grid
styleDirections.emotionalEffect: quiet confidence that the numbers are current

styleDirections.name: Modular Bento
styleDirections.description: Grid of elevated modules with stronger surfaces
tradeoffs: risks card-grid default and decorative depth
conflicts with the user's stated calm feeling
styleDirections.emotionalEffect: energetic and denser, which fights the stated calm

material.surface: opaque canvas and panels, one hairline border

emotionalIntent.goal: calm trust that the numbers are current enough to act on
emotionalIntent.rationale: Support leads make escalation decisions from this screen all day

carriers.visual: opaque surfaces, one accent, tabular numerals
carriers.content: timestamps and time ranges beside every metric

qaQuestions: Is one analytical question dominant above the fold?
Does the calm survive reduced motion and opaque fallbacks?

responsiveContract.tablet: sidebar collapses to icons, analysis stacks
transformations: table keeps priority columns and moves the rest into row disclosure
responsiveContract.zoomAndReflow: 200% zoom reflows to one column with no clipping

performanceBudget.fontPolicy: reuse the project's variable font with a size-adjust fallback

visualQaTargets.comparisonSource: qa.md checklist plus the generated Playwright spec

evidence.claim: Semantic color roles already cover surface, text, border, and status.

regions.need: Understand the queue's pressure at a glance
regions.reason: The foundation metric card already exposes label, value, delta, and timestamp slots
regions.responsive: Metrics stack into a single column below 768px, keeping label and value together

accessibility.semantics: A labelled group with one heading per metric

contentModel.realisticExample: Acme Ltd · 3 open escalations · 12h median response
contentModel.emptyStatePurpose: Say when no accounts are at risk rather than showing zeroes
contentModel.errorRecovery: Keep the last known values with a timestamp and offer refresh

regions.emotionalContribution: Steady calm: numbers update without the page jumping

regions.need: Compare accounts and open the next one
regions.reason: The foundation table supplies sorting, selection, and keyboard row movement, styled by project tokens
regions.responsive: Priority columns stay, remaining columns move into row disclosure below 768px

accessibility.keyboard: Arrow keys move rows, Enter opens the account, sort headers are buttons
accessibility.focus: Focus-visible ring on rows, headers, and the toolbar
accessibility.semantics: role=grid with row and column headers and a caption naming the question

contentModel.realisticExample: Northwind · payment failed twice · Dana W. · 2h ago
contentModel.emptyStatePurpose: Distinguish no accounts at risk from filters that match nothing
contentModel.errorRecovery: Keep filters and scroll, offer retry, keep the header visible

dataViz.question: Which accounts are at risk?
dataViz.textAlternative: A sortable table of accounts with risk reason, owner, and last activity

regions.emotionalContribution: The one region that must feel calm and trustworthy first
